claim: With QLoRA, the frozen base model is loaded in 4-bit precision using NF4.

evidence.quote: Instead of loading the frozen base model at its native 16-bit precision, QLoRA loads it in 4-bit precision using a quantization format called NF4, then trains the LoRA adapter on top of the quantized weights while keeping the adapter’s own math in a higher-precision dtype like bfloat16.
evidence.source_title: How to Fine-Tune an LLM With LoRA: 12 Steps [2026]
